name: mediaelch
summary: [MediaElch](https://github.com/Komet/MediaElch) is a MediaManager for Kodi. Information about Movies, TV Shows, Concerts and Music are stored as nfo files. Fanarts are downloaded automatically from fanart.tv. Using the nfo generator, MediaElch can be used with other MediaCenters as well.

ports.description: MediaElch desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/
